messages.S3「集中」で充電回数をまとめて得て、次にS2「精神の鞭」で10消耗する流れを繰: A Blunt attacker for longer fights. Repeatedly gain a large amount of Charge Count with S3 Concentration, then spend 10 with S2 Mind Whip to grow Charge Potency. As it develops, both S2 and S3 deal more damage.
messages.充電(威力)の育成: バトルパッシブ「脳波充電収束角」(嫉妬×3・保有・同期化Ⅱ: **Growing Charge Potency**: Through the combat passive Brainwave Charge-focusing Antlers (3 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), he gains 1 Charge each time he spends a cumulative 10 Charge Count. At 2 or more Charge, his basic attack skills' Sinking infliction and damage increase.
messages.S3「集中」で回数確保: 使用時に充電回数+5(同期化Ⅳでは+7)、的中時に(充: **Securing Count with S3 Concentration**: +5 Charge Count on use (+7 at Uptie Ⅳ), and increases by (Charge + 1) on hit, up to 6 (Charge + 3, up to 8, at Uptie Ⅳ). Charge Count decreases by 1 at Turn End. At Uptie Ⅳ, 10 or more remains on the next turn so S2 can be used safely, but at Uptie Ⅲ the gain falls short, and using S2 right away lands in the misfire range below. +1 Base Power and Coin Power per Charge, up to 5 each, and damage rises greatly with power. Inflicts 4 Sinking and Sinking Count.
messages.S2「精神の鞭」で消耗: 使用時に充電回数10を消耗してコイン威力が上がり、攻撃: **Spending with S2 Mind Whip**: Spends 10 Charge Count on use for more Coin Power, and if 8 or more remain before attacking, spends 8 more for +40% damage.
messages.S2の暴発に注意: 充電回数が5以上10未満で使うと、自分が沈潜を得て回数を10: **Beware S2's misfire**: Using it with 5–9 Charge Count makes him gain Sinking to top Count up to 10 and turns it into an Unfocused Volley that cannot distinguish friend from foe. At 5 or more Charge Potency, the friend-or-foe restriction does not apply.
messages.その他の獲得手段: S1「エネルギー強打」と守備「エネルギー凝集」も充電回数を得: **Other sources**: S1 Energy Strike and the Defense skill Energy Condensation also grant Charge Count, but the Defense skill only grants +3.
messages.同期化Ⅳでは、序盤にS3を敵に当てて充電回数を確保し、次のターンにS2で10消耗: At Uptie Ⅳ, land S3 on an enemy early to secure Charge Count, then spend 10 with S2 on the next turn to grow Charge Potency (S3→S2). At Uptie Ⅲ, the same sequence falls short of 10 Charge Count and tends to misfire, so add Count with S1 and his Defense skill to reach 10 or more before using S2. Using S2 at 5–9 Charge Count risks hitting allies, so avoid it until Charge Potency reaches 5. The passive requires 3 Envy Owned, so secure Envy alongside spending Count with his Envy S2. He takes time to fully develop and his opening is unstable, so using him at Uptie Ⅳ is preferable.
